description: A card with a live estimate of arrival: minutes left and a status line. Bind `etaMinutes` and `status` to a stream data source value; changes are announced.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline, such as the order or ride.

props.name: etaMinutes
props.description: Minutes until arrival; bind it to a stream data source value.

props.name: status
props.description: The current status text, such as `On the way`.

props.name: minutesLabel
props.description: The unit shown after the minutes.
